picks.editorial_note: An NSF-funded $30 million Science and Technology Center, spanning eight institutions, signals a major national investment in AI-driven turbulence modeling with payoffs across energy, aviation, and fundamental physics.
picks.title: New Center Seeks to Unlock the Science of Turbulence for Energy, Flight, and Discovery

picks.editorial_note: Published in Nature, this work shows AI can design physics experiments that outperform human experts, a genuine methodological breakthrough for how science itself gets done.
picks.title: Artificial Intelligence Suggests New Physics Experiments

picks.editorial_note: HydroGym, published in Nature by an international RWTH-led team, gives researchers a new reinforcement-learning platform for controlling fluid dynamics with direct applications in energy, transportation, and defense systems.
picks.title: Training AI Agents that Can Actively Control Fluid Dynamics in Energy, Transportation, and Defense | RWTH Aachen University | EN

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's GSCo framework pairs a generalist medical AI with specialist models to improve precision healthcare diagnostics, a notable step toward clinically deployable AI systems.
picks.title: Novel AI Framework Unites Generalist and Specialist Models for Precision Healthcare
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: A $7.7 million partnership with the Army Corps of Engineers and DHS to build AI-integrated digital twins of American dams is a concrete example of AI being adopted for critical national infrastructure security.
picks.title: Four years later KU researchers continue their work strengthening American dams

picks.editorial_note: A $2.88 million DOE award to a University of Houston-led team targets AI-driven discovery of next-generation magnets, directly addressing US dependence on foreign-controlled critical mineral supply chains.
picks.title: Department of Energy Awards UH-led Team $2.88M to Use AI to Strengthen America’s Critical Mineral Supply Chain | University of Houston

picks.editorial_note: UT Austin's fusion seed grants tie into DOE's Genesis Mission, a national policy push to use AI to accelerate fusion energy research amid surging investment in the sector.
picks.title: Fusion Energy Seed Grants Launch New Interdisciplinary Collaborations at UT Austin - UT News
picks.university: The University of Texas at Austin

picks.editorial_note: RWTH Aachen's nationwide permit for its Level 4 autonomous research vehicle marks a regulatory milestone, one of only three German universities cleared for such public-road testing.
picks.title: RWTH Receives Nationwide Testing Permit for Autonomous Research Vehicle “karl.” | RWTH Aachen University | EN

picks.editorial_note: EPFL's framework for training AI to express calibrated 'doubt' when proposing experiments is a novel approach that could make AI-assisted scientific discovery more trustworthy and efficient.
picks.title: An AI capable of doubt can optimize scientific discovery

picks.editorial_note: UNSW Canberra's new large-scale robotics and drone testing arena expands one of Australia's biggest such facilities, strengthening ties between researchers, industry, and government on autonomous systems.
picks.title: New facilities expand innovation ecosystem at UNSW Canberra City
